The POST to /api/scoped/investor-reporting/export fires only from the MODAL's OWN 'Create export' button (ExportModal.tsx:257-266, data-slot=submit-export), wired through onSubmit in ExportButton.tsx:193. This criterion's invocation names only one click ('Export'), so the export endpoint is never requested and --delay never has a matching URL to hold. The --delay/--click instrument itself is verified sound: the identical invocation plus an added `--click 'Create export'` DOES print `DELAYED: api/scoped/investor-reporting/export (4000ms)`, and `--delay 'investor-reporting/directory/resolve=4000'` alone (zero clicks, a URL that genuinely fires on page load) also prints DELAYED correctly. This is an order-invocation defect (a missing second click), not a grammar-implementability defect in the flags this cell built; per BOUNDS this criterion is reported as a refusal with its measurement rather than self-graded past, and the invocation is not altered.
